items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with some ancient musicians, like Old Man George Glenny.

ctx.x: Then you started playing with other bands. Did you ever play with a lot of older musicians here, like your uncles and people like that.

My uncles, they were young like me. They’re just about 8, 10 years older than me. I played with some ancient musicians, like Old Man George Glenny. Big Eye Louis Nelson, I played with him. He was crazy about me. He liked me, because I was dressed up all the time. He said, “You’re on the right track with your big papas. You’re on the right track, kid. You keep neat. People call in town.” I said, “Thank you Mr. Louis.” Big Eye, I played with him. Played with so many other musicians that phased out. Can’t think of…
